_ask_line: You fold with conviction. I could make something of that. I'm coming along.
*psst* me too. a dog with no crew is a plan with no raccoon.
_crew_joins: %s join your crew! Now the crews on the road will deal you in.
_play_street: This game's for empty pockets. With $%d, Mossbank's open table will have you.
Sit in? They'll stake you %d chips.
Suit yourself. The crate's not going anywhere.
cash_out_line: You're cleaned out. The $%d buy-in stays on the felt.
You cash out $%d: up $%d on the buy-in.
You cash out $%d, exactly what you sat down with.
You cash out $%d: down $%d on the buy-in.
play: Too few players left at the table for a game. Maybe another day.
The buy-in is $%d and you have $%d. Not today.
Maybe later. The seat isn't going anywhere.
street_line: You hand back their %d and keep $%d. Not bad for a crate.
You hand back their %d chips. Even. Nothing won, nothing owed.
You're under their %d. They wave it off: you owe nothing.

_after_win: You beat %s! They grumble and pay up: $%d.
You won the Mossbank Open! The Regulars hand over the bracelet. Slowly.
_blackout: You wander back toward town, pockets flapping, and everything goes dark...
Rough night, hon? You're at Rosie's. Your wallet's $%d lighter.
Your crew's had pie and a little cry. They're ready when you are.
_encounter: (%s look you over: one dog, no crew.)
_found_lines: That's all four Aces. His deck is whole again. The gate east will let you by.
_interact: The Mossbank bracelet! Pie for the champ. On the house. (Not that House, hon.)
_intro: Sootbridge, late. Coal smoke, rain on the cobbles. And him, coming home.
He lost at the Lamp again tonight. He always loses. Then it's your fault.
He's singing. He doesn't see the cover's off the manhole.
A stumble, a clatter of cards, and he's gone. Down into the dark.
You wait at the edge all night. He doesn't call for you. Nothing comes up.
Morning. You slept by the manhole. His cards lay where they fell.
You gathered them, the way he never did. Four are missing: all four Aces.
They went down with him. But the drains run all over town.
His deck and his wallet. Yours now. You won't leave without those Aces.
Walk: arrows, WASD, D-pad or stick. Talk: A, Enter or Space. Menu: Start or Tab.
_offer_recruit: Ask one of them to join your crew?
%s joins your crew! Pick who sits with you under Crew (Start or Tab).
_offer_tutorial: Well, look who wandered in. A dog, on his own, in my diner. Rough night, hon?
I'm Rosie. New to the tables? I'll show you how they work. Pie after.
Suit yourself, hon. I'm at the diner whenever you want a lesson.
_open_start_menu: Saved! (The game also saves itself at every door and after every match.)
_play_tutorial: Look at you, hon! A natural. Mostly.
Come by for pie, win or lose. Or another lesson.
Fair enough, hon. I'm at the diner if you want another go.
_rest_at_diner: There. Pie all round. Your crew is fed, rested and itching to play.

lines: Sit a while, hon. Nobody leaves Rosie's hungry. Or broke. Well. Hungry.
If a crew cleans you out, you'll wake up in that booth. Happens to everybody.
And don't mind the painting. It came with the place.
npcs.name: Rosie

signs.text: A painting: dogs playing cards. One slips an ace under the table. Did it just wink?

crews.after: *keels over* ...I'm fine. Wear it well. The next town won't be so polite.
before: So. You're the one cleaning out Ridge Road. I'm Graves. I captain the Regulars.
Four of us, same seats every Thursday since 1971. Tonight: either side of you.
Lou's asleep, so signal all you like. We will. Our signals are older than you.
Win the Open and the Mossbank bracelet is yours. You won't.
crews.name: the Mossbank Regulars

lines: Zzz... ante up... zzz...
Zzz... the House... always... zzz...
npcs.name: Lou, the dealer

signs.text: HALL RULES: 1. No biting. 2. No cards in cheek pouches. 3. Do not wake Lou.
Your practice table. The felt has seen better days. So has the deck.
Your practice table. The felt has seen better days. So has the deck.

lines: Sootbridge behind you, Mossbank ahead. Nothing between but the mill and me.
There's a card table in Mossbank, out on the street. Anyone can sit. Even you.
npcs.name: Flint, a carter

lines: The mill's been shut for years. The wheel still turns. Nobody knows why.
You look like you've had a night. Mossbank's kind to strays. Mostly.
npcs.name: Hedda

signs.text: THE MILL ROAD. West: Sootbridge. East: Mossbank. Mind the geese.

gates.text: The gate out of town. You can't leave. Not without the Aces.

after: The drains run all over town, dog. What goes down comes up somewhere.
lines: Mags. I keep the drains. Don't look at me like that, it's honest work.
Found this in my grate at dawn. A card. Smells of him. Of the Lamp's beer.
Here. It's more yours than his, I reckon. Go careful, dog.
npcs.name: Mags

lines: You're his dog. The one he shouted at. ...He's not shouting now, is he?
I won't say sorry. I'll say: the coal yard. Something shines behind the crates.
npcs.name: Ash

lines: They're not opening the manhole. Too deep, the constable says. Too late.
Mum says the drains run under half the town. Even under the washhouse.
npcs.name: Cinder, the sweep

lines: We heard about last night. Sit, if your pockets are empty. We stake you.
npcs.name: Pip

lines: *psst* our chips, your paws. win and you keep the extra. lose and, eh.
npcs.name: Scraps

lines: HONK. PENNIES ON THE CRATE. THE CRATE IS MINE. THE PENNIES ARE ANYONE'S.
npcs.name: Gander

signs.text: SOOTBRIDGE. Mind the drains. The council will fix that manhole cover. Soon.

crews.after: FINE. YOU WIN. WE'LL BE AT THE POND, HONKING ABOUT IT FOR WEEKS.
before: HONK! HALT! THIS IS OUR ROAD NOW. WE DECIDED THAT JUST NOW.
NOBODY PASSES THE POND HECKLERS WITHOUT A HAND. SIT. DEAL. FEAR.
(Nutmeg, the squirrel, holds their chips. In his cheeks. Mostly.)
crews.name: the Pond Hecklers

crews.after: We let you win, obviously. Now move. You're standing in our sunbeam.
before: Oh. A human. With pets. How quaint.
We weren't going to play today. It's warm. But fine. Don't be boring.
(Behind her, the raccoon whispers "psst, I have a plan." Nobody listens.)
crews.name: the Alley Cats

crews.after: We called everything. EVERYTHING. Why didn't that work?!
before: HALT! Halt. Hi. Halt! This stretch of road belongs to the Nut Club!
Toll's one game. Or one nut. No nut? Game it is! Sit sit sit!
Club rule one: we call. Rule two: we always call. Rule three: snacks.
crews.name: the Nut Club

crews.after: *flops over* I have died. Tell my mother I bluffed bravely. ...Shh.
before: Oh. You can see us. Most folks walk right past.
We're the Night Shift. We play at night. It is not night. Deal quietly.
crews.name: the Night Shift

lines: Ridge Road, eh? Crews line it like crows on a fence. Nobody gets by for free.
Step into a crew's sight and they'll deal you in. Win, and one might join you.
Press Start (or Tab) and pick Crew to choose which two animals sit with you.
I played that road forty years. Lost my shirt twice. Won it back once.
npcs.name: Old Bertram

lines: Lou the dealer has been asleep since before I was born. Mom says so.
So in the hall you can signal your crew all you like! Nose! Ear! Hat!
When I grow up I'm gonna have a crew of nine geese. Nine!
npcs.name: Juniper, age 9

lines: Two hundred and twelve! Two hundred and thirteen! Wait. Did I count me?
A dog! Do dogs count? I'll count you. Two hundred and fourteen!
npcs.name: Tally, the census

lines: HONK. THE TABLE BY THE POND IS OPEN TO ALL. EVEN DOGS. ESPECIALLY DOGS.
THEY NEED A FOURTH. THEY ALWAYS NEED A FOURTH. GO ON. SIT.
npcs.name: Dot

lines: Ah. A dog. Do sit, if you have the buy-in. We play for money, not pats.
npcs.name: Sage

lines: *psst* fresh chips. i mean, hi. sit down, sit down.
npcs.name: Bandit

lines: DEAL THE DOG IN. DEAL EVERYONE IN. THIS IS MY TABLE NOW.
npcs.name: Waddles

lines: Sit, if you like. I play slow. If I lose, I lie down for a bit. It's fine.
npcs.name: Pudding

lines: A dog at the table. How novel. Do try not to drool on the felt.
npcs.name: Mittens

signs.text: ROSIE'S DINER. Pie, coffee, booths. Lose on the road? You'll wake up here.
EAST: Ridge Road, then the Tournament Hall. Mostly Ridge Road. Lots of it.
MOSSBANK. Population 212. Squirrels, please stop counting yourselves twice.
SHOP. Closed for the Mossbank Open. The shopkeeper entered. Wish her luck.
MOSSBANK TOURNAMENT HALL. Tonight: the Mossbank Open. Dealer: Lou. Lou: asleep.
OPEN TABLE. Anyone may sit. $100 buy-in. Leave whenever you like.

lines: Out, dog, I've just mopped. ...Oh. You're his. I heard.
Something came up my floor drain this morning. A card. It's by the tubs.
npcs.name: Nell
